name: Wojo Live Rosin | Malibu Marsha
description:
Lineage : Tropicana Cookies x Cookies & Cream F2

Effects: Awaken and Smile

Flavor Profile: Citrus

Bred By: EXOTIC GENETIX

When we deemed this pheno a keeper, she instantly became a coveted company-wide favorite highly recommended to all.

The terp profile will smack you in the face with a sweet orange tang aroma that transfers over perfectly to a full citrus flavor.

Malibu Marsha is a great hybrid strain that will leave your taste buds craving more.
